spec_features.feature_name: first tool-free turn treated as decision to stop
spec_features.spec_quote: we keep it simple and treat the first tool-free turn as the model's own decision to stop
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:149-151 breaks on the FIRST tool-free turn. Note the adjacent comment claims 'We nudge once; if it still does nothing, mark as gave_up' (line 147) but NO nudge is implemented — the code breaks immediately on the first tool-free turn, which exactly matches the 'first tool-free turn = stop' claim.
spec_features.notes: The 'nudge once' comment is not implemented; the actual behavior (stop on first tool-free turn) matches this spec claim.
